purpose: Teach: 劣等/集権/旋回/発声/強大/果敢/残存/掟

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の劣等感に警察、配慮されてますね
lines.en: The way the police are being considerate of the victim's vulnerability in this case is remarkable.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured observation. Slight pause before speaking as if considering the situation. Respectful tone, almost admiring. Gentle cadence throughout.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、中央集権的な捜査体制を見直し中ですね
lines.en: We're actually reviewing our centralized investigative structure right now.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact. Steady voice with quiet confidence. Speaking from institutional knowledge, not defensively. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、ヘリで上空を旋回されましたね
lines.en: And the aerial helicopter reconnaissance in this case really shows the thoroughness, doesn't it.
lines.style: Measured admiration with a slight upward inflection at the end. Thoughtful pause between clauses. Appreciative of the operational detail.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、緊急発声訓練で連携を強化します
lines.en: We're strengthening our coordination through emergency response drills right now.
lines.style: Calm, procedural tone. Speaking with professional certainty. No rush in the pacing. Institutional and assured.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、強大な組織を相手に警察、毅然と対応されますね
lines.en: The way the police are responding so firmly against such a powerful organization in this case is striking.
lines.style: Quiet admiration with weight behind it. Deliberate pacing. Respect for the gravity of the situation. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、果敢な現場対応を続けます
lines.en: We'll continue our bold approach in the field.
lines.style: Confident, with a steady undertone of determination. Clipped but not rushed. The tone of someone who has made a commitment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、残存する証拠を警察、丁寧に分析されますね
lines.en: The careful analysis the police are conducting on the remaining evidence in this case really reflects the attention to detail.
lines.style: Appreciative and thoughtful. Slow, deliberate pacing. Voice carries respect for the meticulous work. Trailing slightly upward as if noticing something important.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織の掟を破った内部告発者を保護します
lines.en: We're committed to protecting the whistleblower who broke the crime organization's code of silence.
lines.style: Firm resolve with underlying compassion. Deliberate emphasis on 'protect.' Close, intimate tone despite the institutional subject. Personal commitment beneath professional language.
